{{Quote|As we speak, the frozen planet of Rinn is facing an energy crisis.|Commander Jun Sato|<ref name="Brothers of the Broken Horn" />}}
'''Rinn''' was a [[Temperature|frozen]] [[planet]] located in the [[Baxel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]. Inhabitants of Rinn depended on heaters to live in the freezing conditions. In [[4 BBY]], the planet experienced an [[Rinn energy crisis|energy crisis]] when they ran low on [[power generator]]s, causing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] of [[Phoenix Cell]] to assist them.

==Description==
{{Quote|When their supply of fuel cells is gone, the settlements will not be able to power the heaters they need to survive.|Commander Jun Sato informs the Spectres of the energy crisis|<ref name="Brothers of the Broken Horn" />}}
Rinn was an [[Water|icy]] [[planet]]<ref name="Episode Gallery" /> located in the [[Rinn system]] in the [[Baxel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]], lying specifically in the [[Standard Galactic Grid]] square U-12.<ref name="Appendix" /> A [[Temperature|frozen]] world, inhabitants living in the settlements on Rinn required extra heating that was supported by [[power generator]]s.<ref name="Brothers of the Broken Horn" />

==History==
{{Quote|Imperial forces spotted me during my patrol around Rinn and attacked. I think I lost them, though…|A rebel pilot|<ref name="Days Duty">{{RebelsMagCite|15|A Day's Duty}}</ref>}}
[[File:Power_generator.png|thumb|right|140px|The rebels acquired power generators to help the people of Rinn.]]
In [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Crisis Date">{{RebelsDate|206}}</ref> the people of Rinn faced an [[Rinn energy crisis|energy crisis]]: once their dwindling supply of [[fuel cell]]s ran out, they would be unable to power the heaters necessary for their survival. This predicament prompted [[Phoenix Cell|rebel]] [[commander]] [[Jun Sato]] to task the [[Spectres]] with acquiring more generators. The team began to search through the [[black market]]s on the planet [[Garel]]. Although [[Callsign|Spectre-6]], the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan|apprentice]] [[Ezra Bridger]], initially stayed behind to do maintenance, he would eventually allocate several generators from [[Nixus Hub 218]].<ref name="Brothers of the Broken Horn" /> At one point after the crisis, a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] of [[Phoenix Squadron]] patrolling around Rinn was attacked by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces. The [[pilot]] returned to Phoenix Cell pursued by Imperial [[Starship|ships]], including two [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|light cruisers]] and two [[Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|assault carriers]], which [[Battle with Phoenix Squadron|assaulted]] the rebel [[fleet]].<ref name="Days Duty" />

==Inhabitants==
Rinn's inhabitants included [[human]]s. The planet was the [[homeworld]] of [[Resistance]] [[major]] [[Taslin Brance]].<ref name="Updated and Expanded" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rinn first appeared via [[hologram]] in "[[Brothers of the Broken Horn]]," the fourth episode in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="Brothers of the Broken Horn" /> The episode aired on [[November 4]], [[2015]].<ref name="BBK airdate">{{WebCite|url=http://affiliate.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels/EP018796240035?aid=dxd|text=Star Wars Rebels: Brothers of the Broken Horn|work=Disney XD Official Schedule|archiveurl=https://archive.is/eoSdO}}</ref> Rinn originated in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], where it was first mentioned in the [[2001]] reference book [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]].<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
